prompt: It is now common for people to change careers several times during their working lives. Why is this happening? Do you think it is a positive or a negative development?
essay:
In the past, most people worked in the same job until their retirement, but now it is normal to change the career two or three times. There are different reasons for this and in my opinion it has advantages and disadvantages.

The first reason is the technology. Many jobs which existed twenty years ago are disappeared now because the computers and the machines can do them, so the workers must learn a new profession. For example, my uncle worked in a printing factory and when the factory closed he had to become a driver. Secondly, the young generation has different values. They do not want to do the same boring work for forty years, they want to develop themselves and to be happy in their job. Also it is easier now to study online, so a person can learn a new skill in the evening without leaving his current job.

On one hand, changing career is positive because people can find a work which they really like and the economy becomes more flexible. On the other hand, it is negative because every time a person start from zero, his salary will be lower and he will have less experience than his colleagues. For example a person who was a manager can become a junior employee again in the new field. Also some people feel stress because they do not have the stability.

In conclusion, people change their career because of the technology and because of the new values, and this development has both positive and negative sides for the workers and the society.
title: Why people now change careers several times
